title: Canonical open restriction of a derived diagonal class
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], and $j:X'\to X$ and $b:S'\to S$ be open immersions, with $f':X'\to S'$ and $f'b=jf$. Use the fibre products [def-pc-fibre-product], derived categories [def-pc-derived-category], derived pullback [def-pc-derived-pullback], and diagonal algebra in degree zero $D_f$ [def-trf-coherent-relative-dualizing-pair]. Define the restriction of $\xi:D_f\to Lp_1^*K$ as the composite $D_{f'}\to rD_f\xrightarrow{r\xi}rLp_1^*K\to Lp_{1'}^*rK$. The first arrow is the inverse of the section-normalized diagonal map: ordinary module base change [def-sfb-module-base-change-map] followed by pullback of the structure sheaf [def-sfb-tensor-pullback-structure-sheaf-map], localized in degree zero. The last arrow is the canonical pullback composition comparison [def-pc-relative-mv-maps], with exact open restriction identified with open pullback by adjunction uniqueness. Thus all comparisons are fixed by their canonical module maps, rather than arbitrary isomorphisms.

def relativeDualizingOpenClass {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (j : X' ⟶ X) (b : S' ⟶ S)
    [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsOpenImmersion b] (h : f' ≫ b = j ≫ f)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X)
    (ξ : DerivedCategory.Q.obj (relativeDualizingDiagonalComplex f) ⟶
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f f)).obj K) :
    DerivedCategory.Q.obj (relativeDualizingDiagonalComplex f') ⟶
      (derivedPullback (pullback.fst f' f')).obj
        ((relativeDualizingOpenRestriction j).mapDerivedCategory.obj K)
